scope: Development-only fold-3/fold-4 sensor-aware ordinal cross-fit; no folds 0/1/2, official paper test, external held outcomes, GHGSat, or failed sources.

architecture.reflectance_conversion: mars_s2l_adapter reflectance_pair is raw DN / 5000; multiply by exactly 0.5 to obtain physical DN / 10000 before clamp [0, 1.5] and linear scale to [-1, 1]

ordinal_targets.source: finite producer enhancement at plume & observable pixels from deterministic inner-training groups only

training.site_balancing: preserve row pools by actual scene label; choose positive groups first, then negative groups excluding groups already used; select one actual scene per chosen group; never duplicate a 25 km group in dense or scene batches; mixed-group no-plume rows remain eligible when their group is not selected positively

evaluation.comparator_alignment: after immutable candidate predictions, exact sample_id/fold/sensor/group
evaluation.dense_comparator: reconstruct released-logit + 0.1 * 2*tanh(frozen Gaussian endpoint dense logit/2), using opposite-fold state and its frozen cloud/component/scene-gate rule; never feed comparator outputs to candidate

smoke.scope: fold-3 fitting rows only; no fold-4 outcome or metric access

preheld_corrective_milestone.radiometry: convert adapter DN / 5000 values by fixed factor 0.5 to physical DN / 10000 before the unchanged clamp and linear scaling
preheld_corrective_milestone.hard_negatives: retain mixed groups in both actual-label row pools; sample positive groups first and negative groups excluding groups already used; one actual scene and one occurrence per group in dense and scene batches
preheld_corrective_milestone.unchanged: outer folds, inner split, seed, architecture widths, schedule, thresholds, comparator, bootstrap, and promotion gates

preheld_execution_amendment.trigger: first execution aborted while constructing the first fitting-fold dense batch because one sampled scene had no source-support crop meeting the frozen 0.70 gate
preheld_execution_amendment.change: resample without replacement from another same-label fitting site; never relax the 0.70 gate and never reuse a site within a batch

preheld_runtime_compatibility_amendment.trigger: The documented WSL DXG SIGBUS occurred before any scientific outcome and produced no result artifact.

runtime_smoke.operation: one full pixel forward/backward/AdamW optimizer step on CUDA at the frozen epoch-1 learning rate

preheld_runtime_compatibility_amendment.forbidden_access: No inner-validation outcome, held outcome, comparator artifact, fold 0/1/2, external evidence, or official evidence.
preheld_runtime_compatibility_amendment.unchanged: batch size, crop size, accumulation, precision, model, seed, schedule, thresholds, comparator, metrics, and gates

one_shot_rules: No held run unless protocol is frozen and every dependency hash matches.
Stop after the fixed seed if any gate fails.
No folds 0/1/2, official paper test, external held outcomes, GHGSat, failed sources, second seed, retuning, or rescue verification.
Recovery artifacts and immutable held parts are bulk ignored and never committed.
Comparator preflight may hash opaque bytes but may not decode comparator values before final candidate immutability.
A validated immutable held part and completed access receipt must be reused on restart; that held fold must not be evaluated again.
A held-access start receipt without a validated part is an explicit incomplete-held-access failure and never authorizes automatic reevaluation.
Configured finalization outputs are accepted only as a validated immutable recovery prefix bound to this protocol and scientific digest; unrelated output remains a hard refusal.

preheld_infrastructure_recovery_amendmen.failure_boundary: held-fold-3 endpoint fitting completed epochs 1 through 9; failure occurred during epoch 10 before any held prediction, semantic comparator access, gate, or result

retry_policy.platform: native Windows CUDA only; WSL is rejected
retry_policy.reason: bypass the failed WSL DXG bridge and WSL p9 filesystem I/O

epoch_recovery.boundary: after all epoch updates, inner validation, best-rank update, and history append; before the next epoch
epoch_recovery.partial_epoch_policy: discard and replay from the last complete validated generation
epoch_recovery.restore_order: construct model, both optimizers, and SiteBalancedBatcher; load model/optimizer state; restore global and batcher RNG states last
epoch_recovery.crash_safety: unique atomic generation files plus atomically replaced latest pointer retaining two validated generations; corrupt newest generation falls back to prior valid generation
required_state: live model state separate from best_state
both AdamW state_dict values, parameter groups, and current learning rates
trainer, model, code dependency, manifest, fold, ordered record, and split hashes
epoch_recovery.resume_rule: resume only when every identity and runtime signature matches and no forbidden artifact or access-ledger mismatch exists

outer_loop_durability.endpoint_boundary: persist immutable endpoint state and metadata before opening that endpoint held fold
outer_loop_durability.access_start_rule: before the one allowed evaluate_candidate call, atomically seal a read-only receipt bound to protocol identity, scientific digest, endpoint recovery identity, ordered held records and sample IDs, fold, and prior access ledger
outer_loop_durability.incomplete_access_rule: a start receipt without a validated immutable part is an explicit incomplete-held-access failure; automatic reevaluation is forbidden
outer_loop_durability.part_rule: atomically publish read-only immediately after the one allowed held evaluation; then atomically seal a completion receipt bound to the start-receipt and part hashes; validate receipt and part together on every restart
outer_loop_durability.second_endpoint_crash_rule: an immutable first held part is reused and can never spend the first held fold twice
outer_loop_durability.final_candidate_rule: both completed held parts must be immutable, validated, merged in exact fold and sample order, and seal-or-validated against the same arrays, identities, bindings, and part/receipt hashes before semantic comparator decode
outer_loop_durability.finalization_state_machine: after final-candidate immutability, comparator reconstruction and metric computation may repeat; endpoint states, exact JSON, and exact Markdown are each seal-or-validated in order without overwrite, training, or held reevaluation
outer_loop_durability.configured_output_recovery_rule: verify_protocol accepts only a consistent immutable prefix of candidate, endpoint states, JSON, and Markdown whose protocol/science/artifact bindings validate; mutable, inconsistent, partial, wrong-protocol, wrong-science, or unrelated outputs are rejected

comparator_access.preflight_allowed: stream opaque bytes only for frozen SHA-256 verification

pre_smoke_portability_amendment.trigger: Native Windows import verification passed, but the clean checkout changed protocol-bound text to CRLF and Windows rejected fsync on descriptors reopened read-only.
pre_smoke_portability_amendment.checkout_contract: Repository attributes force LF for protocol-relevant text and exempt binary scientific/model artifacts from text normalization.
pre_smoke_portability_amendment.durability_contract: Every atomic NumPy, Torch, text, endpoint, recovery-generation, receipt, and pointer write flushes and fsyncs its original writable handle before optional read-only chmod, atomic replace, and supported-platform directory fsync.
pre_smoke_portability_amendment.verification_scope: Cross-platform checkout/hash audit plus focused atomic-writer and RecoveryStore tests; no native runtime smoke and no held evidence.

pre_smoke_serializer_amendment.failure: RecoveryStore CUDA map_location relocated the Torch CPU RNG ByteTensor to CUDA; torch.set_rng_state rejected it before JSON output or restored next-step execution.
pre_smoke_serializer_amendment.serializer_contract: RecoveryStore loads the complete payload on CPU; restore_rng_state validates one-dimensional uint8 Torch RNG entries and passes byte-exact CPU tensors to torch.set_rng_state and torch.cuda.set_rng_state_all; model and optimizer load_state_dict move live state according to model parameters and optimizer policy while best state remains CPU-safe.
pre_smoke_serializer_amendment.allocator_warning: expandable_segments is unsupported and inert on native Windows; the accepted PYTORCH_ALLOC_CONF value did not cause the failure.

corrected_smoke_authorization.scope: fitting-only checkpoint round trip using fold-3 fitting evidence
corrected_smoke_authorization.forbidden: inner-validation outcomes, held data or outcomes, semantic comparator access, folds 0/1/2, external, protected, and official evidence

native_windows_recovery_smoke.scope: fold-3 fitting evidence only; production dense batch size 16; one pixel update and exact checkpoint next-step round trip
